lineage_chain: WT-P20260504_001 (AR threshold overlay PG2 admit STR_1715_AR_threshold_overlay_PG2)
purpose_draft: Draft forge_package — Z-Score Composite alpha redesign grid sweep. 5 variants (V1 normalized sqrt(2) / V2 simple 50/50 / V3 IC-weighted expanding / V4 regime-conditional 4-state / V5 z-score-based defense amplifier in CRISIS/CAUTION). Iter31 linear_tilt_to_penalty_qd weighting + top20 selection. PerformanceAnalytics geometric strict. Best variant vs admit baseline (SR 1.7758) 비교.

V1_equal_norm_sqrt2.rationale: Equal weight with variance normalization (unit-stdev preservation for orthogonal zs)

V2_equal_simple_50_50.rationale: Simple equal weight (most parsimonious — Occam's Razor)

V3_ic_weighted_expanding.formula: z_comp = w_IC_core(t) * z_core + w_IC_def(t) * z_def, w_IC normalized to sum=1, t-1 lag PIT
V3_ic_weighted_expanding.rationale: Adaptive weighting by historical predictive power (expanding window IC, C14 compliant)

V4_regime_4state.formula: z_comp = α(regime) * z_core + (1-α(regime)) * z_def, BULL 0.7/0.3, NORMAL 0.5/0.5, CAUTION 0.3/0.7, CRISIS 0.2/0.8
V4_regime_4state.rationale: Regime-conditional core-defense rotation (4-state alpha_scores regime_state, not BULL/BEAR dichotomy)

V5_defense_amplifier.formula: z_comp = z_core + κ(regime) * z_def, κ_BULL=0.3, κ_NORMAL=0.7, κ_CAUTION=1.5, κ_CRISIS=2.5
V5_defense_amplifier.rationale: Additive defense amplification (sleeve-blend asymmetry — defense scaled by stress, not bounded 0-1 mixing). Tests whether penalty-free amplification beats convex combinations.

selection_pipeline.step_1_composite: Compute z_composite per variant for each (Date, Ticker)
selection_pipeline.step_2_top20: Descending sort by z_composite, top 20 tickers per sig_date (NA score excluded)
selection_pipeline.step_3_liquidity: 20-day avg trade value (Close * Vol) >= 2e8 KRW PIT t-30..t-1, fallback no-filter if <5 names
selection_pipeline.step_4_weighting: Iter31 linear_tilt_to_penalty_qd(lambda=1.5, phi=3, ub=0.20). w_prev from previous period.
selection_pipeline.step_5_returns: Period returns from RAWDATA (start_d, end_d), commission 15bps round-trip on turnover (L1/2)
